newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan woman jailed for abducting child to beg.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan woman jailed for abducting child to beg.

text.p: A Moroccan woman has been sentenced to five years imprisonment for abducting a six-year-old girl and forcing her to beg outside hotels and cafes, the official news agency MAP said on Thursday.
It said the girl, Sanaa Hraichi, was found four months after she disappeared when a man who had seen her picture in a local paper noticed her and telephoned her parents.

The woman, whose name was not given, had dyed the child's hair blonde to avert suspicion, MAP said. The court, in the central Moroccan town of Khouribga, was told that the woman had three children herself.
